name: gym-whatsapp-helpdesk-monorepo
description: Gym WhatsApp Helpdesk and Mock CRM Staging Foundation

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "mock-crm,api,dashboard" -c "magenta,cyan,green" "npm run dev:mock-crm" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=@gym-helpdesk/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@gym-helpdesk/api
scripts.build:crm: npm run build --workspace=@gym-helpdesk/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@gym-helpdesk/mock-crm-api
scripts.build:dashboard: npm run build --workspace=@gym-helpdesk/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@gym-helpdesk/dashboard
